summary: Iteration 2 – Claude Sonnet 5 vision integration for /api/analyze-motion validated end-to-end plus regression pass on prior endpoints and live-feed UI. 8/8 pytest tests pass in ~4s including two full LLM streaming calls with a synthesized 256x256 JPEG (colored vehicle-shaped rectangles + wheels). All 10 required frontend testIDs render, initial values correct (sensitivity 60%, STANDBY, START), START/STOP toggle switches status text and button label, no red-screen errors. Success rate backend 100%, frontend 100%.

issues: Non-blocking console warning still present: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` (react-native-web). Same as iteration_1 – cosmetic only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: silence RN-web pointerEvents deprecation by migrating `pointerEvents='none'` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` on LinearGradient/View wrappers in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx.
NOTE: Real camera frame-diff + TTS pipeline still cannot be exercised in Playwright – requires physical device / Expo Go.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: analyze_motion correctly strips data URI prefix, validates empty image_base64 → 400, catches LLM errors → 502, and safe-defaults classification to 'other' if the model returns anything outside VALID_CLASSES.
server.py: _extract_json robustly handles ```json fences; description falls back to first 80 chars of raw text if JSON parsing fails, so the endpoint never returns an empty description.

server.py: logger is defined AFTER analyze_motion's `logger.exception` call site – currently harmless because logger is module-level and Python resolves at call time, but visually confusing; consider moving logger init above route definitions.
index.tsx: analyzeAndSpeak has a solid fallback path (generic 'Motion detected' TTS on network/API failure). BACKEND_URL uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly.
index.tsx: classification badge only shows after first successful analyze call – no stale-state issue observed; stopMonitoring clears classification/lastDescription.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_<uuid8> status doc inserted by test_status_create_and_persist (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To hit /api/analyze-motion always use a PIL-generated JPEG with real shapes (see _make_jpeg_b64 in test_analyze_motion.py). Data URI prefixes (`data:image/jpeg;base64,...`) are accepted and stripped server-side. Empty body → 422 (pydantic), empty string → 400 (business). Web preview auto-grants camera via CDP so live-feed screen renders directly; if you need to test permission-screen, call `context.clear_permissions()` before goto.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no bugs found. All acceptance criteria in the review request are satisfied.
